title: Celebrating 10 years of Environmental Science: Water Research & Technology
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EW90049A, Editorial
Graham A. Gagnon, Paige J. Novak, David M. Cwiertny
Current Editor-in-Chief Graham Gagnon and former Editors-in-Chief Paige Novak and David Cwiertny reflect on the success of the journal in its 10-year anniversary year.
